dcterms:description: CrackSeg5k dataset is collected from nuclear power plants using a high-resolution camera, comprising 2000 images with a size of 7360 × 4912. The dataset includes various crack widths ranging from 0.05 mm to 15 mm and contains different types of noise, such as varying concrete types and light intensity. The images are sliced into 512 × 512 pixels, resulting in a final dataset of 5560 samples, divided into training, validation, and testing sets with ratios of 90%, 5%, and 5% respectively.
dcterms:title: CrackSeg5k

dcterms:description: Crack500 dataset contains 3368 images of cracks with various shapes and cluttered backgrounds, featuring a large range of crack widths and low contrast between crack and non-crack regions. The dataset is split into training, validation, and testing sets with 1896, 348, and 1124 images respectively.
dcterms:title: Crack500

dcterms:description: CrackTree200 dataset consists of 206 images captured from asphalt pavement, suffering from low contrast between cracks and the surrounding pavement. The dataset is divided into 164 images for training and the remaining for testing.
dcterms:title: CrackTree200

dcterms:description: DRIVE dataset is designed for blood vessel segmentation in medical imaging, containing 40 retina images. The dataset is split into 20 images for training and 20 for testing.
dcterms:title: DRIVE
